name: Happy Crew Cubing CO 2023

venue.name: [Mountainview Christian Church](http://www.mtnvw.org)
venue.details: Main Sanctuary. First floor, directly in line with the front doors.

information: You MUST read the required tabs on the website before registering for the competition. These tabs pertain to COVID-19 safety, and your responsibilities as a competitior. The competitor limit for this competition is only 80 competitors, so be sure to register quick to get a spot! This competition's profits are going to be donated to the nonprofit organization [Happy Crew](https://www.thehappycrew.org/). Happy Crew is a local nonprofit that aims to destigmatize mental health issues through community, and by creating an atmosphere of belonging for its participants. Currently, they are in great need for support due to their new project, Kākou Coffee House, which aims to elevate Happy Crew's mission to a new level.
